reason: No reachable, in-scope, image-serving source on the museum's own infra. (1) The only per-object catalogue is the OPAC at opac.kyotomm.jp (所蔵資料検索) which is geo-fenced/firewalled to Japan: both ports 80 and 443 time out (TCP filtered) from this environment AND via WebFetch's egress (HTTP 000, time_connect=0). Could not retrieve or verify a single object record or image. (2) The reachable main site (kyotomm.jp, WordPress on XSERVER) serves NO artwork images — the /collection/, portrait-corner, and other pages use only base64 placeholder gray-block data URIs; WP REST is 403-blocked by the host WAF; /iiif/, /api/, /opendata/, /data/ all 404; admin-ajax exposes no usable public action. (3) Even if the OPAC were reachable, it is a ~300k-item BIBLIOGRAPHIC library catalog of PUBLISHED manga books, magazines, and research materials (search by keyword/age/title/work) — i.e. printed-book reproductions, explicitly out of scope. The museum's own response to original manga art (原画) is the '原画ダッシュ' (genga-dash) program: physical high-fidelity REPLICA reproductions created precisely because originals are copyright-restricted and not openly digitized. There is no open, downloadable image database of original flat art on the museum's own infrastructure.
easy_source_found: No. Checked {domain}/api,/opendata,/data,/iiif (all 404), WP REST /wp-json (403 XSERVER WAF), admin-ajax (400), Yoast sitemap_index.xml (only posts/pages/events — no collection/object sitemap). The OPAC opac.kyotomm.jp/mm_web_public is the museum's own catalogue platform but is TCP-filtered to Japan (ports 80/443 time out from US egress) and is bibliographic-only (published books), not an image API.
probe_summary: kyotomm.jp homepage and /collection/ reachable (HTTP 200) but carry no real artwork images (base64 placeholders only). OPAC opac.kyotomm.jp = HTTP 000 (TCP port 80+443 filtered/geo-fenced to JP) on curl AND WebFetch. WP REST 403. No IIIF/API/opendata. Confirmed OPAC content is published-book bibliographic records (300k), and original art is only available as physical 原画ダッシュ replicas — copyright-locked, not openly served as ≥600px images.
notes: Two independent disqualifiers, either sufficient: (a) source unreachable/geo-fenced, (b) out-of-scope (published books) + copyright-locked originals. The hint that 'JP site is richer than /en/' is true for human reading but the JP collection pages still contain no machine-readable object data or downloadable images. Re-probe only worthwhile if (i) executed from a Japanese IP/proxy AND (ii) the OPAC is later confirmed to expose original-art (原画) item records with downloadable ≥600px images on opac.kyotomm.jp infra — currently it does not appear to (genga-dash replicas are physical, and the catalogue is bibliographic). For comics/manga, the viable gap-wave targets remain library-platform collections like billy-ireland (OSU CONTENTdm/IIIF) and korea-manhwa (KOMACON/dml.komacon.kr), not kyotomm.jp.
